messages:
maria: Heads up — new HW partner EdgeBox wants per-minute metering but will often upload offline batched files up to 48h late. Need mapping device_id -> customer_id, SKU mapping, and a reconciliation plan. Any immediate blockers?

sarah: We can support late batches but must enforce strong idempotency and dedupe on batch_id/event_id. Who owns SKU mapping on our side?

raj: Partnerships owns logical mapping but we need an agreed SKU id. EdgeBox proposes 'edge_minutes_v1' for consumption and 'edge_seat' for seat entitlements. Their batch payload will look like this: 

```
{
  "batch_id": "uuid-v4",
  "customer_id": "cust_123",
  "device_id": "eb-abcdef",
  "events": [
    {"event_id":"e1","device_ts":"2026-03-18T09:12:00-07:00","minutes":5},
    {"event_id":"e2","device_ts":"2026-03-18T09:20:30-07:00","minutes":1.5}
  ],
  "seat_count": 2,
  "signature": "hmac-sha256..."
}
```

raj: They will send grouped events for the same device in one batch up to 10k events.

oliver: We'll require HMAC signature verification (shared secret) and `batch_id` dedupe TTL = 7 days in staging, 30 days in prod. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/metering/webhooks (ops link)

emily: Two tricky items: 1) plan changes mid-window — we need to attribute usage either to the plan effective at event time or prorate. Current billing engine attributes by invoice period start which will be wrong here. 2) timezone handling — devices report local tz.

maria: Proposal: attribute usage by event `device_ts` in UTC (convert at ingestion) and bill by plan effective at event time. Prorate if plan change crosses event timestamp. For rounding, round up partial minutes to nearest whole minute for billing, but store raw seconds in audit logs. Thoughts?

sarah: Agree on attribution by event time. We'll also add `plan_id` and `plan_effective_ts` optional fields in the batch to make reconciliation deterministic. I'll add spec updates.

raj: Test plan: ask EdgeBox to POST to staging endpoint `/v1/marketplace/usage` with a sandbox API key. Include `batch_id` UUID and `first_seen` header. Example cURL: 

```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/marketplace/usage \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sbx-key-..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @edge_batch.json
```

oliver: For reconciliation, we should run a nightly job that compares aggregated minutes from batches vs device-reported counters (when available). Alert if variance > 2% for a given customer for 3 consecutive days. I'll add the alert to the console.

emily: Also: support late-arriving batches by marking affected invoice windows as "dirty" and re-run aggregation for that window, with an audit log entry describing the change and who triggered it.

maria: Good. Also separate seat-based entitlement ingestion: `seat_count` should update entitlement table immediately (not backfilled), while consumption gets backfilled. EdgeBox wants seat changes to be live for enabled/disabled features.

sarah: I'll update the entitlement contract and send PR. Will include acceptance tests: duplicate `batch_id` ignored, signature verification failure returns 401, late batch re-applies to affected UTC windows and creates audit diffs.

raj: I'll coordinate secret exchange with EdgeBox and schedule an onboarding call Tuesday 10am PT. @billing-bot can you create a sandbox entitlement and trial plan for EdgeBox?

billing-bot: Created sandbox entitlement `edgebox-sandbox` (org sbx-889) and trial plan `edgebox-trial-90d`. API keys provisioned for staging. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks all. Next steps: Sarah PR for spec + tests, Raj secret exchange + onboarding, Oliver add alert, Emily make runbook entry for late-batch reprocessing. We'll schedule a verification run after EdgeBox sends sample batches. :thumbsup:
